def sonnet_judge(prompt: str, timeout: int = 20) -> str:
    """Call Sonnet for scoring/judging tasks. No preamble stripping — returns raw.

    Use this instead of Gemini draft() when rate limits are a problem.
    Slower (~2s per call) but no 429 errors.
    """
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["claude", "-p", "--model", "sonnet", prompt],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=timeout,
